title: Photo Cloud Integration Settings
description: Configuration for specifying cloud storage access for KML processing.

upload_protocol.title: Upload Protocol
upload_protocol.description: Protocol used for uploading image files. Only HTTP_PUT is supported.

upload_url.title: Upload URL
upload_url.description: Base upload endpoint URL. This is the target location where files are PUT.

url_fmt.title: URL Format
url_fmt.description: Format string for generating the hosted image URL, using {photo_path} as the file placeholder.

headers.title: Request Headers
headers.description: HTTP request headers to send when uploading images.

Content-Type.title: Content-Type
Content-Type.description: MIME type to send with the image upload request.
